Name: Idle keeps him alive without wandering
Subsystem: The idle behaviour: keep-alive blinks, small body shuffles and head moves
Purpose: Idle is what runs whenever nothing else does, so a fault here shows up as the robot looking dead or as it drifting across the table over minutes. Neither is visible in one clip.
ExpectedTelemetry: idle decisions print and no behaviour is left running at the end
ExpectedPhysical: He blinks and makes small movements, and he is still roughly where he started after a minute. Nothing repeats mechanically and nothing runs on.
BlockedReason: CR1 (A live body shuffle stops at its duration) is blocked, and IDL depends on it
